strategy.summary: Reproduce PR#880 integer-overflow bug in smile.stat.hypothesis.CorTest at buggy commit 05051592602e887028cb144e11fb4d357eee1fcd. CorTest.spearman computes en3n = n*n*n - n in 32-bit int (overflows for n>=1291, corrupting rho outside [-1,1]); CorTest.kendall uses int pair counters is/n1/n2 that overflow at n>=65537, making tau = is/(sqrt(n1)*sqrt(n2)) return NaN. The PR adds testSpearmanLargeSample and testKendallLargeSample to CorTestTest, which FAIL at this commit and PASS after widening to double/long. Reproduce by running the new tests on the buggy checkout and observing the out-of-range rho and NaN tau; do NOT apply the fix.

input_output_examples.input: CorTest.spearman(x,y).cor() with n=1291, x[i]=i, y[i]=1290-i for i=0..1290 (strictly anti-correlated ranks)
CorTest.spearman(x,y).cor() with n=2000, x[i]=i, y[i]=1999-i for i=0..1999 (strictly anti-correlated ranks)
CorTest.kendall(x,y).cor() with n=65537, x[i]=i, y[i]=i for i=0..65536 (perfectly concordant ranks)
input_output_examples.buggy_output: tau = NaN (int counter is overflows negative, sqrt of negative count)

input_output_examples.input: CorTest.spearman(x,y).cor() with n=1290, x[i]=i, y[i]=n-1-i (control case just below overflow threshold)
input_output_examples.buggy_output: -1.0 (correct at n=1290; serves as in-range control that must still pass)

strategy.summary: At buggy commit 79cbcdab, smile's Gamma.regularizedUpperIncompleteGamma performs a catastrophic-cancellation round trip (1 - (1 - Q)) that quantises tiny upper-tail values to exactly 0.0, and GLM.ztest computes two-sided p-values as 2 - erfc(...) which also floors at 0.0; NegativeBinomialDistribution.p(k) additionally overflows to non-finite values for k > 161. Reproduce by checking out the buggy commit, porting only the PR's new test methods (they are introduced by the PR and absent at the buggy revision), running them with Gradle, and observing the far-tail assertions fail while ordinary-value assertions pass.

strategy.test_selector: GammaTest.testUpperIncompleteGammaFarTail, GammaTest.testUpperIncompleteGammaStrictlyDecreasing, PoissonDistributionTest.testCdfFarTail, NegativeBinomialDistributionTest.testPmfLargeK, ChiSqTestTest.testFarTailPValue, GLMTest (ztest far-tail p-value assertions), BoxTestTest (Ljung-Box far-tail p-value assertions)
strategy.expected_buggy_behavior: The ported far-tail tests fail at the buggy revision: regularizedUpperIncompleteGamma returns 0.0 (or a value near 1.0 through the 1-(1-Q) round trip) for Q(s,x) below ~2^-54 instead of the mpmath tiny positive value; PoissonDistribution.cdf and ChiSqTest.pvalue return 0.0 in the far tail; NegativeBinomialDistribution.p(k) returns non-finite values for k > 161; GLM two-sided z-test p-values and BoxTest Ljung-Box p-values round to 0.0. strategy.expected_fixed_behavior: At the fixed commit 2af97f7d, Gamma.regularizedUpperIncompleteGamma returns Q directly (exp(-x + a*log(x) - loggamma) * prod) and P = 1 - Q, so Q(1.0,50.0) = 1.9287498479639178E-22, Q(0.5,500.0) = 1.7958327848007262E-219, and Q(2,x) decreases strictly; Poisson cdf(300) = 2.8361496727739246E-22; ChiSqTest pvalue = 1.554159431389605E-21; GLM z-test p-values are 4.995317351262854E-108 and 4.331279226426007E-135; BoxTest pvalue = 1.217e-62; NegativeBinomial p(k) is finite for all k up to 400 with p(161) = 0.0011318291241213503 and its sum agrees with cdf(400) to 1E-9.
strategy.success_criterion: With the buggy main sources at 79cbcdab and the PR's far-tail test methods applied, at least one of GammaTest.testUpperIncompleteGammaFarTail / testUpperIncompleteGammaStrictlyDecreasing, PoissonDistributionTest.testCdfFarTail, ChiSqTestTest.testFarTailPValue, NegativeBinomialDistributionTest.testPmfLargeK, GLMTest, BoxTestTest FAILS on the far-tail assertions (wrong value 0.0 or non-finite); the same tests pass once commit 2af97f7d is applied.
risks_or_ambiguities: The reproducing tests are ADDED/MODIFIED by PR #878 and therefore do not exist at the buggy commit; they must be ported from the fixed commit. If the ported test files reference source APIs changed by the fix, compilation at the buggy commit may fail for unrelated reasons.

The mined evidence gives no explicit test_command or test_selector (both empty), and the recorded build commands target ':serve:build' plus 'npm install' rather than the ':base'/':core' unit tests; the Gradle test commands above are inferred from the gradlew wrapper and must be verified.
